verdict.rationale: Documenting a non-resident formation path is a fair question for a state business-registration office, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no page covering foreign-founder eligibility, acceptable foreign IDs or identifiers, or extra steps for non-residents. The registered-agent notes (a business may act as its own agent only if physically located in Delaware) and a Spanish-language video are adjacent material, not a documented non-resident path.
